mapper.select: select id, course_name courseName, teacher, credit, hours from course
select id, course_name courseName, teacher, credit, hours from course where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into course(course_name, teacher, credit, hours) values(#{courseName}, #{teacher}, #{credit}, #{hours})
mapper.select:
select id, course_name, teacher, credit, hours from course
